llm_response.reason: The site shows multiple scam indicators: it claims to be a global professional exchange with registration in the US, but has a brand new domain (registered August 2025) with all contact details hidden and no traceable company information. It offers unusually attractive conditions like zero transaction fees, 100% deposit guarantees, and high technical specs not found with reputable exchanges. Its support email is on a suspicious non-corporate domain. Legal notations are vague, and there is no social media or reputational footprint for the brand in external sources. The combination of fabricated company info, too-good-to-be-true offers, psychological targeting tactics, absence of genuine regulatory information, and lack of reputation fits the profile of a Cryptocurrency Scam.
